Unmodified IEEEtran 1.8b from CTAN: https://ctan.org/pkg/ieeetran
The complete upstream ZIP is retained locally and excluded from Git.
Its public download URL and checksum are recorded in source.json.
IEEEtran.cls and IEEEtran.bst are copied unmodified beside paper.tex because the local TeX installation lacks the IEEEtran package.
Upstream copyright and license notices remain in each class/style file, in
UPSTREAM-README.txt and UPSTREAM-BIBTEX-README.txt, and in the local archive.
